question: avatar is "/me.png". What does src receive?
say: Avatar is slash me dot png. What value does src receive here?
explanation: Inside quotes, curly braces are just characters. src="{avatar}" passes the string "{avatar}". Use src={avatar} to read the variable.
explainSay: The literal text, curly avatar. Inside quotes the braces are just characters. Drop the quotes to read the variable.
